baselines.role: simulation learned reduced dynamics and offline policy-adaptation comparator

paper.title: Learning the Right Abstraction: Neural Reduced Dynamics for Complex Robot Control

code.reuse_rule: Do not vendor or copy code until a repository/license rights review establishes permission. Citing and reproducing the protocol is distinct from copying implementation.

data.dataset_revision_sha256: not yet pinned; must be recorded from the accepted dataset snapshot before raw-file use
data.license: CC-BY-4.0 for corpora, surrogates, fine-tuned policies and scoring records, as declared by the dataset card
data.access_condition: Hugging Face requires accepting the dataset access agreement and sharing account information to access files
data.manifest: MANIFEST.tsv lists per-file SHA-256, size, original run and source machine; verify every consumed file against that manifest.

corpus.skipped_reason: command paths too wide for the finite soil bed; skipped consistently across arms

rigid_control.design: same 24 shards × 50 episodes, seeds, commands, pushes and split definitions as normal corpus
rigid_control.rule: Never pair records from different Chrono build folders. The sbel build folder contains both CRM eval_paths_sb and rigid eval_rigid_sb arms; verify exact same build/session before pairing.

reduced_model.training: one-step training followed by 1.0 s rollout training
reduced_model.policy_finetuning: PPO inside the frozen surrogate, 1024 parallel branches, 2 s per update, 1000 iterations, branch starts sampled from base-policy training states
reduced_model.final_scoring: policy scored again in full Chrono; paired episode by episode against original base policy

reported_results.falls_reported: none in the headline ten-seed recipe table
reported_results.interpretation: Local tracking improvement for one existing policy under the study's simulation and held-out command-path protocol; not evidence of robust physical safety, online terrain identification or hardware transfer.

channel_ablation.sample_size: three surrogate seeds per enriched-channel condition versus ten seeds for the 36-D headline recipe
channel_ablation.interpretation: Additional logged contact channels did not improve average transfer in this specific architecture/dataset/seed budget. This is not evidence that contact sensing has no value; it motivates task-, horizon-, sensor-health- and decision-conditional ablations.

limitations: Local one-round offline improvement of the existing base policy; not online policy learning or a general terrain estimator.
Fine-tuning directly inside Chrono was not run, so do not claim an equal-result compute saving against direct Chrono PPO.
PPO branch starts are drawn from base-policy training states.
The authors report only 0.0–0.1% of fine-tuned policy visitation outside the recorded corpus; surrogate accuracy is local to that data distribution.

Push training windows top out at 140 N while evaluation includes 240–300 N; the study does not establish improved robustness to those larger disturbances. Surrogate disturbance-training did not resolve the gap.
The surrogate guard is an early-warning heuristic, not a safety certificate; one collapse is reported in roughly 60 runs.
The study reports a 36-D control interface closure, not a terrain-history state estimator.

CRM is high-variance and seed/spawn dependent; the source evaluation note reports CRM tracking SD around 5.7 percentage points at ±1 m spawn variation, compared with about 0.1 on rigid ground. Preregister broad replicate distributions and paired per-seed changes; one trajectory is diagnostic only.
The dataset's CRM and rigid data were collected on different Chrono builds; use only score folders whose base and arms share the same exact build.

soil_resolution.claim: The study's soil notes describe the same CRM constitutive model family but deliberately different parameters for HMMWV and Go2.
soil_resolution.benchmark_requirement: Require convergence across particle spacing, smoothing length, foot geometry and solver settings before quantitative terramechanics claims. Matching a constitutive model family does not mean matching physical parameters or resolving the same length scales.
